entries.08e12064baacab0a: Sekisui Jushi Corporation has its head office in Kita-ku, Osaka, and forms a group with 16 domestic subsidiaries, 16 overseas subsidiaries and 3 affiliates.
entries.17b8ecb6a4f0c1f2: Revenue of ¥78,163 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 breaks down, by segment, into external-customer revenue of ¥41,589 million in the public field and ¥36,573 million in the private field. entries.206daec135833591: Sekisui Jushi Corporation has its head office in Kita-ku, Osaka, and forms a group with 16 domestic subsidiaries, 16 overseas subsidiaries and 3 affiliates. Consolidated headcount is 1,621 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.223785c0a2a0d930: Under its management philosophy, 'Creating valuable products through composite technologies and contributing to the safety, security and environment of society through services,' it announced the long-term vision 'Sekisui Jushi Group Vision 2030' in April 2023, and it sets out 'maximizing the value of human capital,' 'expansion through growth strategies' and 'promoting sustainability management' as its basic policies. The management plan for that interim period, the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2027' (fiscal years ended March 2025 through March 2027), states that it will focus management resources on growth areas, namely new domains, new businesses and overseas operations, and will strengthen the deepening of existing technologies, the acquisition of new technologies, and product development responding to next-generation transport technologies.
